snippet.title: Witchfire - Official Revelations Update Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the latest Witchfire trailer for this single-player, dark fantasy RPG shooter from developer The Astronauts to see what's coming with the Revelations update. Witchfire's Revelations update brings the Marshland, a hostile wetland map with new enemies. The update also features localization for 15 languages, a new gear pack with four distinct weapons, and a dialogue system. You can now engage in multi-threaded conversations with Fallen Preyers, making pivotal choices that impact both gameplay and story. Witchfire is out now in Early Access on PC (Steam and Epic Games Store). The Revelations update for Witchfire is out today, June 18, 2026.
